assumption: Idealized upper bound: same player, same period, no deliberate style change.

precision_at_k_scope.precision_at_k_mutual_rank: Apply the report threshold, sort by ascending mutual rank and descending score, then apply the report cap.
precision_at_k_scope.precision_at_k_mutual_rank_unfiltered: Same order across all eligible pairs, without the threshold or cap.
precision_at_k_scope.precision_at_k: Descending score across all eligible pairs, without the threshold or cap.

precision_at_k_ties: Break ties by ascending account names. Each result is null if fewer than K pairs are available.
